changelog:
• ♾️ Continuous Infinite Scroll: Fixed home carousels that stopped loading after the first page — Popular Movies, HF Direct, and Indian/Top Rated now keep paging seamlessly as you scroll
• 🎯 Smooth Focus & No Jumps: Removed the focus-shift and 'jump to start' glitch when new items loaded; your position stays put while more titles append at the end
• 🚀 Earlier Prefetch: Rows now fetch the next page well before you reach the edge, so slower catalogs load in time for uninterrupted D-pad scrolling
• 🛠️ Category-Switch Race Fix: Eliminated spurious reloads and premature 'end of catalog' detection when quickly switching between category rows
